# `denoise`

Denoise channel TIFFs and compute denoising QC metrics

- Wrapper: [`job_denoising.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_denoising.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_denoise`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.denoising`

## Inputs

- general.raw_images_folder (default tiffs/)
- general.metadata_folder/panel.csv

## Outputs

- general.denoised_images_folder (default processed/)
- outputs/<execution_id>_Denoising/ plus reusable denoised channel images

## Configuration

- general, denoising, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl denoise
```
